summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of EdgeClients signed-bundle submit + verify flow. All three required UI flows pass against the live preview URL.

test_results.case: Signed-out: Sign & Anchor Bundle button is disabled and sign-in hint visible
Sign in via top-right user-switcher as Asha Verma (Developer); Acting role: Developer appears
Fill prompt_hash=sha256:test123, tool_calls, output_text containing AWS key; submit button becomes enabled
Click submit-bundle-btn -> success toast 'Bundle signed & anchored (ledger #1546) · 1 sensitive value(s) masked'; new bundle appears in Signed Bundles with hash and masked AWS key (AK****LE)
Click verify-bundle-btn-<id> -> verify-result-<id> badge shows 'Verified' and toast 'Bundle verified — hash & signature intact'
Sign out via user-switcher -> submit button returns to disabled with sign-in hint

critical_code_review_comments: EdgeClients.jsx — on submit error toast falls back to 'Submission failed — sign in and pick an assigned role' which is specific; fine. No issues found in wiring.
test_credentials: Used demo user u-asha (Asha Verma, Developer) via /api/auth/demo-login triggered by user-switcher
seed_data_creation: Created 1 new signed bundle (EC-01, prompt sha256:test123, masked AWS key). Existing seeded bundles (EC-02, EC-01) were visible and used for verify sanity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EdgeClients page frontend wiring is confirmed end-to-end. user-switcher is a native <select>; use page.select_option('[data-testid="user-switcher"]', value='u-asha') to sign in (clicking the <option> fails). Backend ledger_seq counter was at #1546 after this run.
